About Us

Shanghai-Based. Globally Minded.

Yazhou Weimei Limited is a China-based engineering and international sourcing company combining Chinese manufacturing strength with world-class project management expertise.

We act as your dedicated bridge to China's industrial ecosystem — from supplier selection and factory audits to project execution and logistics. Our clients benefit from reduced costs, improved quality control, and the confidence of working with an experienced on-the-ground partner.

Integrity

Transparent communication and honest representation in all transactions.

Quality

Rigorous QC processes at every stage from factory to final delivery.

Reliability

On-time delivery and consistent performance across all projects.

Innovation

Continuously adopting better sourcing and engineering methods.

Long-Term Partnership

We build lasting relationships, not just transactions.

Cranes & Lifting Equipment

Industrial Lifting Solutions

Gantry cranes, overhead cranes, and custom lifting equipment engineered and supplied from China's leading crane manufacturers.

Gantry Cranes

Single and double girder gantry cranes for outdoor and semi-outdoor use. Capacity: 5–500 tons. Span: up to 35m.

Overhead Bridge Cranes

Indoor workshop cranes with standard and explosion-proof options. Capacity: 1–500 tons. Class A3–A7.

Semi-Gantry Cranes

Hybrid design using one runway rail at height and one ground rail. Ideal for limited indoor/outdoor space.

Hoists & Winches

Electric chain hoists, wire rope hoists, and industrial winches. 0.5–80 ton capacity, various suspension types.

Jib Cranes

Column-mounted and wall-mounted jib cranes for flexible workshop material handling. 0.25–10 ton range.

Material Handling Systems

Custom handling solutions including monorail systems, transfer carts, and automated handling equipment.

Typical Specifications

Lifting Capacity 1 – 500 Tons
Span Range 3 – 35 Meters
Lifting Height 3 – 30 Meters
Work Duty Class A3, A4, A5, A6, A7
Power Supply Custom to Site
Standards FEM / ISO / GB
CE Compliance Available on Request

Quality Assurance

Built-In Quality at Every Stage

We don't just source — we verify. Our quality assurance processes protect your investment and ensure every project meets international standards.

1

Supplier Qualification

Rigorous pre-qualification process covering manufacturing capability, financial stability, certifications, and production capacity.

2

Factory Audits

On-site factory assessments by our technical team covering processes, equipment, workforce, and quality management systems.

3

Production Monitoring

In-process monitoring with progress reports, photos, and video documentation shared directly with clients.

4

Third-Party Inspection

Independent pre-shipment inspections by accredited third-party inspection agencies where required.

5

Technical Documentation

Complete technical packages including operation manuals, maintenance guides, certificates, and as-built drawings.

6

After-Sales Support

Ongoing technical support, spare parts supply coordination, and warranty management post-delivery.

Compliance

CE Marking Support

We assist suppliers in meeting CE requirements for equipment exported to European markets.

Standards

EN / ISO Standards

Specification, procurement, and documentation aligned with EN, ISO, and local market standards.

Documentation

Material Certificates

Mill certificates, test reports, and material traceability documentation for structural and pressure equipment.

Audit

Quality Management

Preferred suppliers hold ISO 9001 certification and maintain documented QMS processes.
